```csharp
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding - use ArcFace model if available, otherwise use fallback
            float[] liveEmbedding = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? 
                GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : 
                ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                string mode = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? "ArcFace" : "Fallback";
                Debug.Log($"🔍 [{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate ArcFace embedding using OpenCV DNN model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob for OpenCV DNN (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // Scale factor
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),  // Size
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // Mean subtraction
                    true,  // Swap RB channels
                    false  // Crop
                );

                // Set input and run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding from output
                float[] embedding = new float[output.Total()];
                output.GetArray(out embedding);

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating ArcFace embedding with OpenCV DNN: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features from a face image using basic OpenCV operations
        /// FALLBACK MODE - lower accuracy than ArcFace but no model loading required
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat normalized = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert to grayscale if needed
                Mat grayFace = faceGrayMat;
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    grayFace = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, grayFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                }

                // Resize to consistent size
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayFace, resized, new Size(FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE, FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE));

                // Normalize
                normalized = new Mat();
                Cv2.EqualizeHist(resized, normalized);

                // Extract simple features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE * FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                var indexer = normalized.GetGenericIndexer<byte>();
                
                int idx = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        features[idx++] = indexer[y, x] / 255.0f;
                    }
                }

                // Normalize the feature vector
                float magnitude = 0.0f;
                foreach (float val in features)
                {
                    magnitude += val * val;
                }
                magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

                if (magnitude > 0.0f)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < features.Length; i++)
                    {
                        features[i] /= magnitude;
                    }
                }

                if (grayFace != faceGrayMat)
                {
                    grayFace.Dispose();
                }

                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting simple features: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                resized?.Dispose();
                normalized?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
```
```csharp
        }
    }
}

        {

            Debug.Log($"📦 Attempting to load ArcFace model from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, copy from StreamingAssets to persistent data path
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {

                    {

                        yield break;

        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }

                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // Scale factor
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),  // Size
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // Mean subtraction
                    true,  // Swap RB channels
                    false  // Crop
                );

                // Set input and run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                output.GetArray(out embedding);

        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat normalized = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert to grayscale if needed
                Mat grayFace = faceGrayMat;
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    grayFace = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, grayFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                }

                // Resize to consistent size
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayFace, resized, new Size(FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE, FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE));

                // Normalize
                normalized = new Mat();
                Cv2.EqualizeHist(resized, normalized);

                // Extract simple features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE * FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                var indexer = normalized.GetGenericIndexer<byte>();
                
                int idx = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; x++)
                    {

                // Normalize the feature vector
                float magnitude = 0.0f;
                foreach (float val in features)
                {

                }
                magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

                if (magnitude > 0.0f)
                {

                if (grayFace != faceGrayMat)

        /// <summary>

        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }
```

## **Why TensorFlow Lite Should Work:**

1. **Different runtime** - TensorFlow Lite has its own ONNX model loader, completely separate from Unity Barracuda
2. **Better mobile support** - TFLite is specifically designed for mobile/embedded devices like Magic Leap 2
3. **More flexible** - TFLite handles more ONNX opset versions and model formats
4. **Native Android support** - TFLite has excellent Android x86_64 support

## **The Process:**
```
ONNX Model → TensorFlow → TensorFlow Lite (.tflite)
     ↓           ↓              ↓
  (Any opset) → (TF format) → (Mobile optimized)
```

## **What This Fixes:**
- ❌ **Unity Barracuda**: "Format version not supported: 21" 
- ✅ **TensorFlow Lite**: Should handle opset 7+ without issues
- ✅ **Better compatibility**: TFLite is more forgiving with model formats
- ✅ **Optimized for mobile**: Designed for devices like Magic Leap 2

## **The Key Difference:**
- **Barracuda**: Unity's inference engine (limited ONNX support)
- **TensorFlow Lite**: Google's mobile inference engine (extensive ONNX support)

So yes, you should be able to use the same ONNX model (or even convert it to TFLite format) without the version compatibility issues we had with Barracuda!

### **Method 1: Download from GitHub**

4. Select the downloaded ZIP

### **Method 2: Git URL (if you have Git)**
1. In Unity Package Manager
2. Click **"+"** button
3. Select **"Add package from git URL"**
4. Enter: `https://github.com/google/tensorflow-lite-unity-sample.git`

### **Method 3: Clone Repository**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/google/tensorflow-lite-unity-sample.git
# Then copy the contents to your Assets folder
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert ONNX model to TensorFlow format for Unity Barracuda compatibility.
Barracuda often works better with TensorFlow models than ONNX.
"""

import onnx
import onnx_tf
import os
import sys

def convert_onnx_to_tensorflow(input_onnx_path, output_tf_path):
    """
    Convert ONNX model to TensorFlow SavedModel format.
    
    Args:
        input_onnx_path (str): Path to input ONNX model
        output_tf_path (str): Path to output TensorFlow model directory
    """
    try:
        print(f"🔄 Converting ONNX model to TensorFlow...")
        print(f"   Input:  {input_onnx_path}")
        print(f"   Output: {output_tf_path}")
        
        # Check if input file exists
        if not os.path.exists(input_onnx_path):
            print(f"❌ ERROR: Input model not found: {input_onnx_path}")
            return False
        
        # Load ONNX model
        print("📦 Loading ONNX model...")
        onnx_model = onnx.load(input_onnx_path)
        
        # Validate ONNX model
        onnx.checker.check_model(onnx_model)
        print("✅ ONNX model validation passed")
        
        # Convert ONNX to TensorFlow
        print("🔄 Converting ONNX to TensorFlow...")
        tf_rep = onnx_tf.backend.prepare(onnx_model)
        
        # Export as TensorFlow SavedModel
        print("💾 Exporting TensorFlow model...")
        tf_rep.export_graph(output_tf_path)
        
        print("✅ Conversion completed successfully!")
        print(f"📁 TensorFlow model saved to: {output_tf_path}")
        
        return True
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ ERROR: Conversion failed: {e}")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Default paths
    input_model = "Assets/StreamingAssets/arcface.onnx"
    output_dir = "Assets/StreamingAssets/arcface_tf"
    
    # Check if custom paths provided
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        input_model = sys.argv[1]
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        output_dir = sys.argv[2]
    
    print("🚀 ONNX to TensorFlow Converter")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    success = convert_onnx_to_tensorflow(input_model, output_dir)
    
    if success:
        print("\n🎉 SUCCESS!")
        print("📝 Next steps:")
        print("   1. Copy the TensorFlow model to your Unity project")
        print("   2. Update LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer to use TensorFlow format")
        print("   3. Use Barracuda's TensorFlow model loading instead of ONNX")
    else:
        print("\n❌ FAILED!")
        print("💡 Try checking:")
        print("   - ONNX model file exists and is valid")
        print("   - All required packages are installed")
        print("   - Model doesn't use unsupported operators")
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Unity.Barracuda;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight face recognition using pre-computed embeddings + runtime ArcFace model.
    /// 
    /// TWO MODES:
    /// 1. FULL MODE (Recommended): Uses ArcFace model on device for best accuracy
    ///    - Uses OpenCV DNN for ONNX model loading (better compatibility than Barracuda)
    ///    - Works with standard ONNX models without format conversion issues
    ///    
    /// 2. FALLBACK MODE: Uses simple feature extraction (lower accuracy)
    ///    - Automatically used if model fails to load
    ///    - Still uses PC-generated ArcFace embeddings for comparison
    /// </summary>
    public class LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Runtime Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace model in StreamingAssets")]
        public string modelPath = "arcface.onnx"; // Model file in StreamingAssets
        
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for recognition (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;
        
        [Tooltip("Use fallback mode (simple features) if model loading fails")]
        public bool useFallbackIfModelFails = true;

        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private const int FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE = 64; // Simple feature extraction size (fallback mode)
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private Net _dnnModel; // OpenCV DNN model
        private bool _isInitialized = false;
        private bool _isUsingFallbackMode = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }


        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer...");
            
            // Try to load model first
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());
            
            // Load embeddings
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                if (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized in FULL MODE (ArcFace model loaded with OpenCV DNN)!");
                }
                else if (_isUsingFallbackMode)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Running in FALLBACK MODE (simple features) - accuracy may be lower");
                    Debug.LogWarning("💡 OpenCV DNN model failed to load - check model file and format");
                }
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization failed - No embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load ArcFace model using OpenCV DNN (with fallback handling)
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Attempting to load ArcFace model from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, copy from StreamingAssets to persistent data path
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Model file not found: {www.error}");
                        if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                        {
                            Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                            _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                        }
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ ArcFace model not found: {fullPath}");
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            // Try to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN
            try
            {
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(fullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    throw new System.Exception("Net.ReadNetFromONNX returned null or empty model");
                }

                FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(fullPath);
                float modelSizeMB = fileInfo.Length / (1024.0f * 1024.0f);
                Debug.Log($"✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN! Size: {modelSizeMB:F2} MB");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with OpenCV DNN: {e.Message}");
                
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("🔄 Switching to fallback mode (simple features)...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📂 Loading embeddings from: {filePath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding - use ArcFace model if available, otherwise use fallback
            float[] liveEmbedding = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? 
                GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : 
                ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                string mode = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? "ArcFace" : "Fallback";
                Debug.Log($"🔍 [{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate ArcFace embedding using OpenCV DNN model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob for OpenCV DNN (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // Scale factor
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),  // Size
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // Mean subtraction
                    true,  // Swap RB channels
                    false  // Crop
                );

                // Set input and run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding from output
                float[] embedding = new float[output.Total()];
                output.GetArray(out embedding);

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating ArcFace embedding with OpenCV DNN: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features from a face image using basic OpenCV operations
        /// FALLBACK MODE - lower accuracy than ArcFace but no model loading required
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat normalized = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert to grayscale if needed
                Mat grayFace = faceGrayMat;
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    grayFace = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, grayFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                }

                // Resize to consistent size
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayFace, resized, new Size(FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE, FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE));

                // Normalize
                normalized = new Mat();
                Cv2.EqualizeHist(resized, normalized);

                // Extract simple features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE * FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                var indexer = normalized.GetGenericIndexer<byte>();
                
                int idx = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        features[idx++] = indexer[y, x] / 255.0f;
                    }
                }

                // Normalize the feature vector
                float magnitude = 0.0f;
                foreach (float val in features)
                {
                    magnitude += val * val;
                }
                magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

                if (magnitude > 0.0f)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < features.Length; i++)
                    {
                        features[i] /= magnitude;
                    }
                }

                if (grayFace != faceGrayMat)
                {
                    grayFace.Dispose();
                }

                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting simple features: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                resized?.Dispose();
                normalized?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace Recogneyes

        {

            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());

            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());

        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Attempting to load ArcFace model from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, copy from StreamingAssets to persistent data path
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {

#endif

                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {

                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>

        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding - use ArcFace model if available, otherwise use fallback
            float[] liveEmbedding = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? 
                GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : 
                ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                string mode = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? "ArcFace" : "Fallback";
                Debug.Log($"🔍 [{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }
```

```csharp
            // Try to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN
            try
            {
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(fullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    throw new System.Exception("Net.ReadNetFromONNX returned null or empty model");
                }

                FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(fullPath);
                float modelSizeMB = fileInfo.Length / (1024.0f * 1024.0f);
                Debug.Log($"✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN! Size: {modelSizeMB:F2} MB");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with OpenCV DNN: {e.Message}");
                
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("🔄 Switching to fallback mode (simple features)...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📂 Loading embeddings from: {filePath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding - use ArcFace model if available, otherwise use fallback
            float[] liveEmbedding = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? 
                GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : 
                ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                string mode = (_dnnModel != null && !_dnnModel.Empty()) ? "ArcFace" : "Fallback";
                Debug.Log($"🔍 [{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate ArcFace embedding using OpenCV DNN model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob for OpenCV DNN (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // Scale factor
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),  // Size
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // Mean subtraction
                    true,  // Swap RB channels
                    false  // Crop
                );

                // Set input and run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding from output
                float[] embedding = new float[output.Total()];
                output.GetArray(out embedding);

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating ArcFace embedding with OpenCV DNN: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features from a face image using basic OpenCV operations
        /// FALLBACK MODE - lower accuracy than ArcFace but no model loading required
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat normalized = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert to grayscale if needed
                Mat grayFace = faceGrayMat;
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    grayFace = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, grayFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                }

                // Resize to consistent size
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayFace, resized, new Size(FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE, FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE));

                // Normalize
                normalized = new Mat();
                Cv2.EqualizeHist(resized, normalized);

                // Extract simple features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE * FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                var indexer = normalized.GetGenericIndexer<byte>();
                
                int idx = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        features[idx++] = indexer[y, x] / 255.0f;
                    }
                }

                // Normalize the feature vector
                float magnitude = 0.0f;
                foreach (float val in features)
                {
                    magnitude += val * val;
                }
                magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

                if (magnitude > 0.0f)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < features.Length; i++)
                    {
                        features[i] /= magnitude;
                    }
                }

                if (grayFace != faceGrayMat)
                {
                    grayFace.Dispose();
                }

                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting simple features: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                resized?.Dispose();
                normalized?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        /// <summary>
```

```csharp
        private void LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(string jsonContent)
        {

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate ArcFace embedding using Barracuda model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Barracuda worker not available, using fallback");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }

            try
            {
                // Resize to model input size
                OpenCvSharp.Mat resized = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new OpenCvSharp.Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));
                
                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                OpenCvSharp.Mat rgb = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.CvtColor(resized, rgb, OpenCvSharp.ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);
                
                // Normalize to [0,1] and convert to tensor
                Tensor inputTensor = new Tensor(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                
                // Get pixel data and populate tensor
                var pixelData = rgb.GetArray(out byte[] pixels);
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        int pixelIndex = y * MODEL_INPUT_SIZE * 3 + x * 3;
                        
                        // Normalize to [0,1] and set tensor values
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 0] = pixels[pixelIndex + 0] / 255.0f;     // R
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 1] = pixels[pixelIndex + 1] / 255.0f;     // G
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 2] = pixels[pixelIndex + 2] / 255.0f;     // B
                    }
                }
                
                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();
                
                // Cleanup
                inputTensor.Dispose();
                output.Dispose();
                resized.Dispose();
                rgb.Dispose();
                
                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ ArcFace inference failed: {e.Message}");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features as fallback (LBPH-like approach)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Resize to standard size
                OpenCvSharp.Mat resized = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new OpenCvSharp.Size(64, 64));
                
                // Extract histogram features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                
                // Simple histogram-based features
                for (int i = 0; i < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; i++)
                {
                    int x = (i * 64) / FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE;
                    int y = (i * 64) / FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE;
                    features[i] = resized.At<byte>(y, x) / 255.0f;
                }
                
                resized.Dispose();
                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Simple feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                return new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE]; // Return zero features
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize face using either ArcFace model or fallback features
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Generate embedding
                float[] liveEmbedding = _worker != null ? GenerateArcFaceEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                string mode = _worker != null ? "ArcFace" : "Fallback";
                
                if (liveEmbedding == null || liveEmbedding.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"[{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Embedding length mismatch: {embedding1.Length} vs {embedding2.Length}");
                return 0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            float norm1 = 0f;
            float norm2 = 0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                norm1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                norm2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 == 0f || norm2 == 0f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Check if system is ready for recognition
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsReady()
        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownEmbeddings.Count > 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Check if using full ArcFace mode or fallback
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsUsingFullMode()
        {
            return _worker != null && !_isUsingFallbackMode;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
            _runtimeModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class EmbeddingsData
    {
        public PersonData[] people;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class PersonData
    {
        public string name;
        public float[][] embeddings;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Dnn;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Editor-only tool to preprocess training images and generate embeddings using the large ArcFace model.
    /// This runs ONLY in the Unity Editor on your PC, not on Magic Leap 2.
    /// Uses OpenCV DNN module instead of Barracuda for better compatibility.
    /// The generated embeddings are small and can be loaded on the device.
    /// </summary>
    public class FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Editor-Only Settings (PC)")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace ONNX model (in Assets folder)")]
        public string onnxModelPath = "Models/arcface.onnx";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to training data folder (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string trainingDataFolder = "Faces";
        
        [Tooltip("Where to save the generated embeddings (relative to StreamingAssets)")]
        public string embeddingsOutputPath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Header("Processing Status")]
        public bool isProcessing = false;
        public int totalImagesProcessed = 0;
        public string statusMessage = "Ready to process";
        
        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private Net _dnnModel;

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embeddings for all training images (call from Inspector context menu)
        /// </summary>
        [ContextMenu("Generate Embeddings (Editor Only)")]
        public void GenerateEmbeddings()
        {
            if (Application.isPlaying)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ This tool should only be used in Edit mode, not Play mode!");
                return;
            }

            Debug.Log("🚀 Starting embedding generation on PC...");
            isProcessing = true;
            totalImagesProcessed = 0;

            try
            {
                // Load the large ArcFace model using OpenCV DNN
                string modelFullPath = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, onnxModelPath);
                
                if (!File.Exists(modelFullPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Model file not found: {modelFullPath}");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log($"📦 Loading model from: {modelFullPath}");
                _dnnModel = Net.ReadNetFromONNX(modelFullPath);
                
                if (_dnnModel == null || _dnnModel.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ONNX model with OpenCV DNN");
                    return;
                }

                Debug.Log("✅ Large model loaded successfully with OpenCV DNN!");

                // Process all training images
                string trainingDataPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, trainingDataFolder);
                
                if (!Directory.Exists(trainingDataPath))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Training data folder not found: {trainingDataPath}");
                    return;
                }

                // Dictionary to hold embeddings for each person
                Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> allEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();

                // Get all person folders
                string[] personFolders = Directory.GetDirectories(trainingDataPath);
                Debug.Log($"📂 Found {personFolders.Length} people to process");

                foreach (string personFolder in personFolders)
                {
                    string personName = Path.GetFileName(personFolder);
                    
                    if (personName == "Unknown" || personName.StartsWith("."))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    Debug.Log($"📸 Processing {personName}...");
                    statusMessage = $"Processing {personName}...";

                    // Get all images for this person
                    string[] imageExtensions = { "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.bmp" };
                    List<string> imageFiles = new List<string>();
                    
                    foreach (string extension in imageExtensions)
                    {
                        imageFiles.AddRange(Directory.GetFiles(personFolder, extension, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
                    }

                    if (imageFiles.Count == 0)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found for {personName}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    List<float[]> personEmbeddings = new List<float[]>();

                    // Process each image
                    foreach (string imagePath in imageFiles)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            float[] embedding = GenerateEmbeddingForImage(imagePath);
                            if (embedding != null)
                            {
                                personEmbeddings.Add(embedding);
                                totalImagesProcessed++;
                            }
                        }
                        catch (System.Exception e)
                        {
                            Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing {imagePath}: {e.Message}");
                        }
                    }

                    if (personEmbeddings.Count > 0)
                    {
                        allEmbeddings[personName] = personEmbeddings;
                        Debug.Log($"✅ Generated {personEmbeddings.Count} embeddings for {personName}");
                    }
                }

                // Save embeddings to file
                SaveEmbeddingsToFile(allEmbeddings);

                Debug.Log($"🎉 SUCCESS! Processed {totalImagesProcessed} images for {allEmbeddings.Count} people!");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Fatal error during embedding generation: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                _dnnModel?.Dispose();
                isProcessing = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a single image using OpenCV DNN
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbeddingForImage(string imagePath)
        {
            Mat image = null;
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Load image
                image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                if (image.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                rgbImage = new Mat();
                Cv2.CvtColor(image, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob from image (normalized to [0, 1])
                // OpenCV DNN expects: (batch, channels, height, width)
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // scale factor - Normalize to [0, 1]
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // mean
                    false,  // swapRB - We already converted to RGB
                    false   // crop
                );

                // Run inference
                _dnnModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _dnnModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                int embeddingSize = (int)output.Total();
                float[] embedding = new float[embeddingSize];
                
                // Get indexer for safe access
                var indexer = output.GetGenericIndexer<float>();
                
                // Copy data from Mat to array
                for (int i = 0; i < embeddingSize; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] = indexer[0, i];
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing image {imagePath}: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                image?.Dispose();
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Save embeddings to JSON file
        /// </summary>
        private void SaveEmbeddingsToFile(Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> embeddings)
        {
            string outputPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsOutputPath);
            
            // Convert to serializable format
            EmbeddingsData data = new EmbeddingsData
            {
                embeddings = new List<PersonEmbeddings>()
            };

            foreach (var kvp in embeddings)
            {
                PersonEmbeddings personData = new PersonEmbeddings
                {
                    name = kvp.Key,
                    embeddings = new List<EmbeddingVector>()
                };

                foreach (float[] embedding in kvp.Value)
                {
                    personData.embeddings.Add(new EmbeddingVector { values = embedding });
                }

                data.embeddings.Add(personData);
            }

            // Serialize to JSON
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, prettyPrint: true);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json);

            Debug.Log($"💾 Embeddings saved to: {outputPath}");
            Debug.Log($"📦 File size: {new FileInfo(outputPath).Length / 1024.0:F2} KB");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _dnnModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // Serializable classes for JSON export
    [System.Serializable]
    public class PreprocessorEmbeddingsData
    {
        public List<PersonEmbeddings> embeddings;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class PersonEmbeddings
    {
        public string name;
        public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public class EmbeddingVector
    {
        public float[] values;
    }
}
```

```csharp
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();

        private IWorker _worker; // Barracuda worker
        private bool _isInitialized = false;
        private bool _isUsingFallbackMode = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer...");
            
            // Try to load model first
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());
            
            // Load embeddings
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                if (_worker != null)
                {
                    Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized in FULL MODE (ArcFace model loaded with Barracuda)!");
                }
                else if (_isUsingFallbackMode)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Running in FALLBACK MODE (simple features) - accuracy may be lower");
                    Debug.LogWarning("💡 Barracuda model failed to load - check model file and format");

                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization failed - No embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load ArcFace model using Barracuda (with multiple worker type attempts)
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Attempting to load ArcFace model from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, copy from StreamingAssets to persistent data path
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {

                        {
                            Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                            _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                        }
                        yield break;

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ ArcFace model not found: {fullPath}");
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {

                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            try
            {
                // Load model using Barracuda
                byte[] modelData = File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
                _runtimeModel = ModelLoader.Load(modelData);
                
                if (_runtimeModel == null)
                {
                    throw new System.Exception("ModelLoader.Load returned null model");
                }
                
                Debug.Log("✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with Barracuda!");
                
                // Try different worker types for better compatibility
                WorkerFactory.Type[] workerTypes = {

                    WorkerFactory.Type.CSharpBurst,
                    WorkerFactory.Type.ComputePrecompiled,
                    WorkerFactory.Type.Compute
                };
                
                foreach (var workerType in workerTypes)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🔄 Trying worker type: {workerType}");
                        _worker = WorkerFactory.CreateWorker(workerType, _runtimeModel);
                        
                        if (_worker != null)
                        {
                            Debug.Log($"✅ Worker created successfully with type: {workerType}");
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (System.Exception e)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Worker type {workerType} failed: {e.Message}");
                        _worker?.Dispose();
                        _worker = null;
                    }
                }
                
                if (_worker == null)
                {
                    throw new System.Exception("All worker types failed to create worker");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with Barracuda: {e.Message}");
                
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
            }
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
```
