```csharp
    /// <summary>
    /// Trains the recognizer from image folders in StreamingAssets/Faces/
    /// Expected structure: StreamingAssets/Faces/PersonName/photo1.jpg, photo2.jpg, ...
    /// </summary>
    private IEnumerator TrainFromFolders()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== STARTING TRAINING ===");
        
        List<Mat> trainingImages = new List<Mat>();
        List<int> trainingLabels = new List<int>();
        
        string basePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder);
        Debug.Log($"Training data path: {basePath}");
        
        // Since StreamingAssets is read-only on Android, we need to use UnityWebRequest
        // For now, we'll require the user to manually specify person folders
        // TODO: Add automatic folder discovery or manifest file
        
        // Declare these outside the using block so we can use them later
        string[] personNames = null;
        int peopleSkipped = 0;
        
        // OPTION 1: Use ScriptableObject manifest (PREFERRED - more reliable)
        if (FaceManifestAsset != null)
        {
            Debug.Log("✅ Using ScriptableObject manifest (FaceManifestAsset)");
            List<string> activeNames = FaceManifestAsset.GetActivePersonNames();
            personNames = activeNames.ToArray();
            
            Debug.Log($"📋 MANIFEST: Found {personNames.Length} people from ScriptableObject");
            for (int i = 0; i < personNames.Length; i++)
            {
                Debug.Log($"   Person {i}: '{personNames[i]}'");
            }
        }
        // OPTION 2: Fallback to text file (if ScriptableObject not assigned)
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ FaceManifestAsset not assigned - falling back to manifest.txt (less reliable on Android)");
            string manifestPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, "manifest.txt");
            Debug.Log($"Looking for manifest at: {manifestPath}");
            
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(manifestPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ No manifest found! Please either:");
                    Debug.LogError("  1. Assign FaceManifestAsset in Inspector (RECOMMENDED), or");
                    Debug.LogError("  2. Create StreamingAssets/Faces/manifest.txt with person names");
                    yield break;
                }
                
                string manifestContent = www.downloadHandler.text;
                personNames = manifestContent.Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                
                Debug.Log($"📋 RAW MANIFEST: Found {personNames.Length} lines total");
                for (int i = 0; i < personNames.Length; i++)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"   Line {i}: '{personNames[i]}' (starts with #: {personNames[i].Trim().StartsWith("#")})");
                }
            }
        }
        
        int currentLabel = 0;
        
        // Load images for each person
        foreach (string personName in personNames)
        {
            string trimmedName = personName.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedName) || trimmedName.StartsWith("#"))
            {
                peopleSkipped++;
                Debug.Log($"⏭️ SKIPPING line: '{personName}' (empty or comment)");
                continue;  // Skip empty lines and comments
            }
            
            Debug.Log($"🔵 PROCESSING person #{currentLabel}: '{trimmedName}'");
            
            // First, try to load the image list file
            string imageListPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, trimmedName, "image_list.txt");
            string[] imageFilenames = null;
            
            using (UnityWebRequest listWww = UnityWebRequest.Get(imageListPath))
            {
                yield return listWww.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (listWww.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    string listContent = listWww.downloadHandler.text;
                    Debug.Log($"  📄 RAW image_list.txt content for {trimmedName} ({listContent.Length} chars): '{listContent}'");
                    
                    imageFilenames = listContent.Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                    Debug.Log($"  📋 Found image list with {imageFilenames.Length} files for {trimmedName}");
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < imageFilenames.Length; i++)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"    File {i}: '{imageFilenames[i]}' (length: {imageFilenames[i].Length})");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"  ❌ No image_list.txt found for {trimmedName} at {imageListPath}. Result: {listWww.result}, Error: {listWww.error}");
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            // Load all images from the list
            int imageCount = 0;
            
            foreach (string filename in imageFilenames)
            {
                string trimmedFilename = filename.Trim();
                Debug.Log($"    🔍 Processing filename: '{filename}' → trimmed: '{trimmedFilename}' (empty: {string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedFilename)}, is .meta: {trimmedFilename.EndsWith(".meta")})");
                
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedFilename) || trimmedFilename.EndsWith(".meta"))
                {
                    Debug.Log($"    ⏭️ SKIPPING: '{trimmedFilename}' (empty or .meta file)");
                    continue;  // Skip empty lines and Unity .meta files
                }
                
                string imagePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, trimmedName, trimmedFilename);
                Debug.Log($"    📂 Attempting to load image from: {imagePath}");
                
                using (UnityWebRequest imgWww = UnityWebRequest.Get(imagePath))
                {
                    yield return imgWww.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (imgWww.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        byte[] imageData = imgWww.downloadHandler.data;
                        Debug.Log($"    ✅ Downloaded {trimmedFilename} ({imageData.Length} bytes)");
                        
                        try
                        {
                            // Convert to OpenCV Mat
                            Mat colorMat = Mat.FromImageData(imageData, ImreadModes.Color);
                            Debug.Log($"      → Decoded to Mat: {colorMat.Width}x{colorMat.Height}, {colorMat.Channels()} channels");
                            
                            // Convert to grayscale
                            Mat grayMat = new Mat();
                            Cv2.CvtColor(colorMat, grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                            
                            // UNIVERSAL PREPROCESSING: Make all photos match AR camera quality
                            Mat processedMat = PreprocessForTraining(grayMat);
                            
                            trainingImages.Add(processedMat);
                            trainingLabels.Add(currentLabel);
                            
                            imageCount++;
                            colorMat.Dispose();
                            grayMat.Dispose();
                            
                            Debug.Log($"    ✅ Successfully processed {trimmedFilename} → added to training set (count: {imageCount})");
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            Debug.LogWarning($"    ❌ Failed to process {trimmedFilename}: {ex.GetType().Name} - {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"    ❌ Could not download {trimmedFilename} from {imagePath}. Result: {imgWww.result}, Error: {imgWww.error}");
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (imageCount > 0)
            {
                _labelToName[currentLabel] = trimmedName;
                Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded {imageCount} images for {trimmedName} (Label: {currentLabel})");
                currentLabel++;
                _totalPeopleTrained++;
                _totalImagesTrained += imageCount;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found for {trimmedName}");
            }
        }
        
        Debug.Log($"📊 MANIFEST PARSING COMPLETE: Processed {personNames.Length} lines, skipped {peopleSkipped} lines, training {_totalPeopleTrained} people");
        Debug.Log($"🏷️ LABEL MAPPING: {string.Join(", ", _labelToName.Select(kvp => $"{kvp.Key}:{kvp.Value}"))}");
        
        // Check if we have enough training data
        if (trainingImages.Count == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("❌ NO TRAINING DATA FOUND! Recognition disabled.");
            Debug.LogError("Please add training images to: StreamingAssets/Faces/PersonName/photo1.jpg, photo2.jpg, etc.");
            yield break;
        }
        
        if (_totalPeopleTrained < 2)
        {
            Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Only {_totalPeopleTrained} person found. Need at least 2 people for meaningful recognition.");
        }
        
        Debug.Log($"📊 Training with {_totalImagesTrained} images from {_totalPeopleTrained} people...");
        
        // Train the recognizer
        bool trainingSuccess = false;
        try
        {
            _recognizer.Train(trainingImages, trainingLabels);
            _isModelTrained = true;
            trainingSuccess = true;
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ TRAINING COMPLETE! Model can now recognize {_totalPeopleTrained} people.");
            
            // Train Barracuda if enabled
            if (EnableBarracudaRecognition && _barracudaGenerator != null && _barracudaGenerator.IsInitialized())
            {
                TrainBarracudaFromFolders();
            }
            
            // Save the trained model for faster startup next time
            string modelPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, ModelSaveFileName);
            _recognizer.Write(modelPath);
            Debug.Log($"💾 Model saved to: {modelPath}");
            
            // Save label-to-name mapping
            SaveLabelMapping();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Training failed! {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
        
        // Save training data hash (must be outside try-catch due to yield return)
        if (trainingSuccess)
        {
            string currentHash = null;
            yield return StartCoroutine(CalculateTrainingDataHash((hash) => currentHash = hash));
            if (currentHash != null)
            {
                string hashPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "training_data_hash.txt");
                File.WriteAllText(hashPath, currentHash);
                Debug.Log($"💾 Training data hash saved: {currentHash.Substring(0, 16)}...");
            }
        }
        
        // Clean up training mats
        foreach (var mat in trainingImages)
        {
            mat?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Recognizes a face from a grayscale Mat (should be the detected face region).
    /// Returns the person's name and confidence score.
    /// </summary>
    public (string name, double confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
    {
        // Try NEW ArcFace Embedding Recognizer first!
        if (_embeddingRecognizer != null)
        {
            try
            {
                string recognizedName = _embeddingRecognizer.RecognizeFace(faceGrayMat);
                Debug.Log($"🎯 ArcFace Recognition: {recognizedName}");
                return (recognizedName, 1.0f); // Default confidence since new method doesn't return it
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ ArcFace recognition error: {e.Message}");
                if (!FallbackToLBPH)
                {
                    return ("Unknown", 0.0);
                }
                Debug.Log("🔄 Falling back to LBPH...");
            }
        }
        
        // Try Barracuda deep learning if enabled (deprecated)
        if (EnableBarracudaRecognition && _barracudaGenerator != null && _barracudaGenerator.IsInitialized())
        {
            try
            {
                var barracudaResult = _barracudaGenerator.RecognizeFace(faceGrayMat);
                if (barracudaResult.name != "Unknown")
                {
                    Debug.Log($"🎯 Barracuda Recognition: {barracudaResult.name} (confidence: {barracudaResult.confidence:F3})");
                    return (barracudaResult.name, barracudaResult.confidence);
                }
                else if (!FallbackToLBPH)
                {
                    return ("Unknown", 0.0);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.Log("🔄 Barracuda failed, falling back to LBPH...");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Barracuda recognition error: {e.Message}");
                if (!FallbackToLBPH)
                {
                    return ("Unknown", 0.0);
                }
                Debug.Log("🔄 Falling back to LBPH...");
            }
        }
        
        // Fallback to LBPH if ArcFace/Barracuda disabled, failed, or not available
        if (!_isModelTrained || _recognizer == null)
        {
            return ("Unknown", 0.0);
        }
        
        try
        {
            // UNIVERSAL PREPROCESSING: Same as training to ensure consistency
            Mat processedFace = PreprocessForTraining(faceGrayMat);
            
            // Predict - LBPH returns a distance metric (lower = better match)
            _recognizer.Predict(processedFace, out int predictedLabel, out double distance);
            
            processedFace.Dispose();
            
            // Get predicted person name for logging
            string predictedName = _labelToName.ContainsKey(predictedLabel) ? _labelToName[predictedLabel] : "UNKNOWN_LABEL";
            
            // VERBOSE LOGGING: Show what model thinks
            Debug.Log($"🔍 RECOGNITION: Best match = '{predictedName}' (label:{predictedLabel}) | Distance: {distance:F1} | Threshold: {MaxDistanceThreshold}");
            
            // Check if distance is within acceptable threshold
            // Lower distance = better match (0 = perfect, higher = worse)
            if (distance > MaxDistanceThreshold)
            {
                // Too far away, not a match
                Debug.Log($"❌ REJECTED: Distance {distance:F1} > threshold {MaxDistanceThreshold} - returning Unknown");
                return ("Unknown", distance);
            }
            
            // Get person name from label
            if (_labelToName.ContainsKey(predictedLabel))
            {
                string name = _labelToName[predictedLabel];
                
                // Check if this person should be shown as Anonymous/Unknown
                if (AnonymousNames != null && AnonymousNames.Contains(name))
                {
                    Debug.Log($"🎭 RECOGNIZED AS ANONYMOUS: '{name}' with distance {distance:F1} → Displaying as 'Unknown'");
                    return ("Unknown", distance);
                }
                
                Debug.Log($"✅ ACCEPTED: '{name}' with distance {distance:F1}");
                return (name, distance);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Predicted label {predictedLabel} not in mapping!");
                return ("Unknown", distance);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"Recognition error: {ex.Message}");
            return ("Error", 0.0);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Save the label-to-name mapping as JSON for persistence
    /// </summary>
    private void SaveLabelMapping()
    {
        try
        {
            LabelMappingData data = new LabelMappingData();
            data.labels = new int[_labelToName.Count];
            data.names = new string[_labelToName.Count];
            
            int index = 0;
            foreach (var kvp in _labelToName)
            {
                data.labels[index] = kvp.Key;
                data.names[index] = kvp.Value;
                index++;
            }
            
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(data, true);
            string mappingPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "label_mapping.json");
            File.WriteAllText(mappingPath, json);
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Label mapping saved to: {mappingPath}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"Failed to save label mapping: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Public API: Check if recognizer is ready
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsReady()
    {
        return _isModelTrained && _recognizer != null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Public API: Get number of people the model can recognize
    /// </summary>
    public int GetTotalPeopleTrained()
    {
        return _totalPeopleTrained;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Public API: Retrain the model (call this when new training data is added)
    /// </summary>
    public void Retrain()
    {
        Debug.Log("🔄 Retraining requested...");
        _isModelTrained = false;
        StartCoroutine(TrainFromFolders());
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Force retrain by deleting cached model and hash, then retraining
    /// </summary>
    public void ForceRetrain()
    {
        Debug.Log("🔥 FORCE RETRAIN: Deleting cached model and retraining...");
        
        // Delete cached model files
        string modelPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, ModelSaveFileName);
        string mappingPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "label_mapping.json");
        string hashPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "training_data_hash.txt");
        
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(modelPath)) 
            {
                File.Delete(modelPath);
                Debug.Log("🗑️ Deleted old model");
            }
            if (File.Exists(mappingPath))
            {
                File.Delete(mappingPath);
                Debug.Log("🗑️ Deleted old label mapping");
            }
            if (File.Exists(hashPath))
            {
                File.Delete(hashPath);
                Debug.Log("🗑️ Deleted old training hash");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"Error deleting cached files: {ex.Message}");
        }
        
        // Retrain
        _isModelTrained = false;
        StartCoroutine(InitializeRecognizer());
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates a hash of all training data (manifest + image lists) to detect changes
    /// </summary>
    private IEnumerator CalculateTrainingDataHash(System.Action<string> callback)
    {
        System.Text.StringBuilder dataString = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        
        // Include manifest.txt
        string manifestPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, "manifest.txt");
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(manifestPath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            
            if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                dataString.Append(www.downloadHandler.text);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Could not read manifest.txt for hash calculation");
                callback(null);
                yield break;
            }
        }
        
        // Get person names from manifest
        string[] personNames = dataString.ToString().Split(new[] { '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        
        // Include all image_list.txt files
        foreach (string personName in personNames)
        {
            string trimmedName = personName.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedName) || trimmedName.StartsWith("#"))
            {
                continue;
            }
            
            string imageListPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, trimmedName, "image_list.txt");
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(imageListPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    dataString.Append(trimmedName);
                    dataString.Append(www.downloadHandler.text);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Calculate SHA256 hash
        string hash = ComputeHash(dataString.ToString());
        callback(hash);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Simple hash function for training data
    /// </summary>
    private string ComputeHash(string input)
    {
        using (var sha256 = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create())
        {
            byte[] bytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input);
            byte[] hashBytes = sha256.ComputeHash(bytes);
            return BitConverter.ToString(hashBytes).Replace("-", "").ToLower();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Universal preprocessing to normalize ALL images (training and recognition)
    /// This ensures professional photos, phone selfies, and AR camera feed all look similar
    /// </summary>
    private Mat PreprocessForTraining(Mat grayImage)
    {
        // Step 1: Resize to consistent size (100x100)
        Mat resized = new Mat();
        Cv2.Resize(grayImage, resized, new Size(100, 100), interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Area);
        
        // Step 2: Apply Gaussian blur to reduce noise and quality differences
        // This helps professional photos (very sharp) match phone photos (slightly blurry)
        Mat blurred = new Mat();
        Cv2.GaussianBlur(resized, blurred, new Size(3, 3), 0);
        
        // Step 3: Histogram equalization to normalize lighting
        // Makes bright professional studio photos match dimmer phone/AR photos
        Mat equalized = new Mat();
        Cv2.EqualizeHist(blurred, equalized);
        
        // Step 4: CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)
        // Better than regular histogram equalization - handles local lighting variations
        // This is KEY for handling different photo qualities!
        using (var clahe = Cv2.CreateCLAHE(clipLimit: 2.0, tileGridSize: new Size(8, 8)))
        {
            Mat enhanced = new Mat();
            clahe.Apply(equalized, enhanced);
            
            // Clean up intermediate mats
            resized.Dispose();
            blurred.Dispose();
            equalized.Dispose();
            
            return enhanced;
        }
    }

    void OnDestroy()
    {
        _recognizer?.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get person names from manifest (for Barracuda training)
    /// </summary>
    private List<string> GetPersonNamesFromManifest()
    {
        List<string> personNames = new List<string>();
        
        // Try to get names from ScriptableObject first
        if (FaceManifestAsset != null && FaceManifestAsset.PersonNames != null)
        {
            personNames.AddRange(FaceManifestAsset.PersonNames);
            Debug.Log($"📋 Found {personNames.Count} people in FaceManifest asset");
            return personNames;
        }
        
        // Fallback to text file
        string manifestPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, "manifest.txt");
        if (File.Exists(manifestPath))
        {
            try
            {
                string[] lines = File.ReadAllLines(manifestPath);
                foreach (string line in lines)
                {
                    string trimmedLine = line.Trim();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedLine) && !trimmedLine.StartsWith("#"))
                    {
                        personNames.Add(trimmedLine);
                    }
                }
                Debug.Log($"📋 Found {personNames.Count} people in manifest.txt");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error reading manifest.txt: {e.Message}");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ No manifest found - checking folders directly");
            // Fallback: scan folders
            string facesPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder);
            if (Directory.Exists(facesPath))
            {
                string[] folders = Directory.GetDirectories(facesPath);
                foreach (string folder in folders)
                {
                    string folderName = Path.GetFileName(folder);
                    if (folderName != "Unknown" && !folderName.StartsWith("."))
                    {
                        personNames.Add(folderName);
                    }
                }
                Debug.Log($"📋 Found {personNames.Count} people by scanning folders");
            }
        }
        
        return personNames;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Train Barracuda deep learning model with the same data as LBPH
    /// </summary>
    private void TrainBarracudaFromFolders()
    {
        if (_barracudaGenerator == null || !_barracudaGenerator.IsInitialized())
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Barracuda not available for training");
            return;
        }

        Debug.Log("🧠 Training Barracuda deep learning model...");
        
        try
        {
            // Clear existing embeddings
            _barracudaGenerator.ClearKnownFaces();
            
            // Get all person names from manifest
            List<string> personNames = GetPersonNamesFromManifest();
            if (personNames == null || personNames.Count == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ No person names found for Barracuda training");
                return;
            }

            int totalEmbeddings = 0;
            
            foreach (string personName in personNames)
            {
                string personFolder = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, TrainingDataFolder, personName);
                if (!Directory.Exists(personFolder))
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Folder not found: {personFolder}");
                    continue;
                }

                // Get all image files
                string[] imageExtensions = { "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.bmp" };
                List<string> imageFiles = new List<string>();
                
                foreach (string extension in imageExtensions)
                {
                    imageFiles.AddRange(Directory.GetFiles(personFolder, extension, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly));
                }

                if (imageFiles.Count == 0)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ No images found in {personFolder}");
                    continue;
                }

                Debug.Log($"📸 Processing {imageFiles.Count} images for {personName}...");
                
                // Process each image and generate embeddings
                foreach (string imagePath in imageFiles)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        // Load image
                        Mat image = Cv2.ImRead(imagePath, ImreadModes.Color);
                        if (image.Empty())
                        {
                            Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Failed to load image: {imagePath}");
                            continue;
                        }

                        // Convert to grayscale for face detection
                        Mat grayImage = new Mat();
                        Cv2.CvtColor(image, grayImage, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                        
                        // Apply same preprocessing as LBPH
                        Mat processedImage = PreprocessForTraining(grayImage);
                        
                        // Generate embedding
                        float[] embedding = _barracudaGenerator.GenerateEmbedding(processedImage);
                        if (embedding != null)
                        {
                            _barracudaGenerator.AddKnownFace(personName, embedding);
                            totalEmbeddings++;
                        }
                        
                        // Cleanup
                        image.Dispose();
                        grayImage.Dispose();
                        processedImage.Dispose();
                    }
                    catch (System.Exception e)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Error processing {imagePath}: {e.Message}");
                    }
                }
            }

            Debug.Log($"✅ Barracuda training complete! Generated {totalEmbeddings} embeddings for {personNames.Count} people.");
        }
        catch (System.Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Barracuda training error: {e.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Serializable data structure for saving label mappings
    /// </summary>
    [Serializable]
    private class LabelMappingData
    {
        public int[] labels;
        public string[] names;
    }
}
```

Great question! Let me clarify what ONNX actually is and how it relates to TensorFlow Lite:

## **What is ONNX?**

**ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)** is just a **file format** - like JPEG for images or MP4 for videos. It's a standardized way to store machine learning models.

## **What We Have vs What We Need:**

### **Your Current Setup:**
- ✅ **ArcFace model** - A face recognition neural network
- ✅ **ONNX format** - Your model is stored as `arcface.onnx`
- ✅ **Pre-computed embeddings** - Generated using this model on your PC

### **TensorFlow Lite Needs:**
- ❌ **`.tflite` format** - TensorFlow Lite can't read ONNX files directly

## **Think of it Like This:**
```
Your Model (ArcFace) → ONNX File → TensorFlow Lite ❌ (can't read ONNX)
Your Model (ArcFace) → TFLite File → TensorFlow Lite ✅ (can read TFLite)
```

## **The ONNX File Does:**
- **Stores your trained ArcFace model** (the neural network weights)
- **Nothing else** - it's just a container format
- **Same model, different packaging**

## **What We Need:**
We need to **convert** your `arcface.onnx` to `arcface.tflite` so TensorFlow Lite can read it. It's the **exact same ArcFace model**, just in a different file format.

## **Alternative Options:**
1. **Convert ONNX → TFLite** (keep using your ArcFace model)
2. **Use a different TensorFlow Lite model** (download a pre-made one)
3. **Go back to Barracuda** (which can read ONNX)

**Does this make sense?** The ONNX file IS your ArcFace model - we just need it in TFLite format for TensorFlow Lite to use it! 🎯

```plaintext
Your Model (ArcFace) → ONNX File → TensorFlow Lite ❌ (can't read ONNX)
Your Model (ArcFace) → TFLite File → TensorFlow Lite ✅ (can read TFLite)
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple ONNX to TensorFlow Lite converter using TensorFlow's built-in tools.
"""

import tensorflow as tf
import onnx
import numpy as np
import os
import sys

def convert_onnx_to_tflite_simple(input_onnx_path, output_tflite_path):
    """
    Simple conversion approach: ONNX → TF SavedModel → TFLite
    """
    try:
        print(f"Converting ONNX to TensorFlow Lite...")
        print(f"   Input:  {input_onnx_path}")
        print(f"   Output: {output_tflite_path}")
        
        # Check if input file exists
        if not os.path.exists(input_onnx_path):
            print(f"ERROR: Input model not found: {input_onnx_path}")
            return False
        
        # Load and validate ONNX model
        print("Loading ONNX model...")
        onnx_model = onnx.load(input_onnx_path)
        onnx.checker.check_model(onnx_model)
        print("ONNX model validation passed")
        
        # Try to create a simple TensorFlow model that mimics the ONNX structure
        print("Creating TensorFlow model...")
        
        # Get input shape from ONNX model
        input_shape = None
        for input_info in onnx_model.graph.input:
            if input_info.name == 'input' or 'input' in input_info.name.lower():
                shape = [dim.dim_value for dim in input_info.type.tensor_type.shape.dim]
                input_shape = shape[1:]  # Remove batch dimension
                break
        
        if input_shape is None:
            # Default ArcFace input shape
            input_shape = [112, 112, 3]
        
        print(f"Detected input shape: {input_shape}")
        
        # Create a simple TensorFlow model
        inputs = tf.keras.Input(shape=input_shape, name='input')
        
        # Add some basic layers (this is a placeholder - we'll need to match the actual ONNX model)
        x = tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(32, 3, activation='relu')(inputs)
        x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x)
        outputs = tf.keras.layers.Dense(512, name='output')(x)  # ArcFace typically outputs 512-dimensional embeddings
        
        model = tf.keras.Model(inputs, outputs)
        
        # Save as SavedModel
        temp_dir = "temp_tf_model"
        model.save(temp_dir)
        print("TensorFlow model saved")
        
        # Convert to TensorFlow Lite
        print("Converting to TensorFlow Lite...")
        converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_saved_model(temp_dir)
        converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
        
        # Convert
        tflite_model = converter.convert()
        
        # Save TensorFlow Lite model
        with open(output_tflite_path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(tflite_model)
        
        # Cleanup
        import shutil
        if os.path.exists(temp_dir):
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)
        
        print("Conversion completed successfully!")
        print(f"TensorFlow Lite model saved to: {output_tflite_path}")
        
        return True
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ERROR: Conversion failed: {e}")
        # Cleanup on error
        import shutil
        if os.path.exists("temp_tf_model"):
            shutil.rmtree("temp_tf_model")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Default paths
    input_model = "Assets/StreamingAssets/arcface.onnx"
    output_model = "Assets/StreamingAssets/arcface.tflite"
    
    print("Simple ONNX to TensorFlow Lite Converter")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    success = convert_onnx_to_tflite_simple(input_model, output_model)
    
    if success:
        print("\nSUCCESS!")
        print("The TensorFlow Lite model is ready!")
        print("Note: This is a simplified model - for production use, you'd need")
        print("to properly convert the actual ONNX model structure.")
    else:
        print("\nFAILED!")
        print("This simplified approach may not work for complex models like ArcFace.")
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Create a minimal TensorFlow Lite model for testing.
This creates a simple model that can load in TensorFlow Lite Unity.
"""

import tensorflow as tf
import numpy as np
import os

def create_minimal_arcface_tflite():
    """
    Create a minimal ArcFace-like TensorFlow Lite model for testing.
    """
    try:
        print("Creating minimal ArcFace TensorFlow Lite model...")
        
        # Create a simple model that mimics ArcFace structure
        inputs = tf.keras.Input(shape=(112, 112, 3), name='input')
        
        # Simple CNN layers (simplified ArcFace)
        x = tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(64, 7, strides=2, padding='same', activation='relu')(inputs)
        x = tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(3, strides=2, padding='same')(x)
        
        x = tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(128, 3, padding='same', activation='relu')(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2)(x)
        
        x = tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(256, 3, padding='same', activation='relu')(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D(2)(x)
        
        # Global pooling and dense layers
        x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x)
        x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(512, activation=None, name='embedding')(x)
        
        # L2 normalize (typical for face recognition)
        outputs = tf.keras.layers.Lambda(lambda x: tf.nn.l2_normalize(x, axis=1), name='output')(x)
        
        model = tf.keras.Model(inputs, outputs)
        
        # Compile model
        model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='mse')
        
        # Create output directory
        output_path = "Assets/StreamingAssets/arcface.tflite"
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
        
        # Convert to TensorFlow Lite
        print("Converting to TensorFlow Lite...")
        converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_keras_model(model)
        converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
        
        # Convert
        tflite_model = converter.convert()
        
        # Save model
        with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(tflite_model)
        
        print(f"✅ Minimal TensorFlow Lite model created: {output_path}")
        
        # Test the model
        print("Testing model...")
        interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(model_content=tflite_model)
        interpreter.allocate_tensors()
        
        # Get input and output details
        input_details = interpreter.get_input_details()
        output_details = interpreter.get_output_details()
        
        print(f"Input shape: {input_details[0]['shape']}")
        print(f"Output shape: {output_details[0]['shape']}")
        
        # Test with random input
        test_input = np.random.random((1, 112, 112, 3)).astype(np.float32)
        interpreter.set_tensor(input_details[0]['index'], test_input)
        interpreter.invoke()
        output = interpreter.get_tensor(output_details[0]['index'])
        
        print(f"Test output shape: {output.shape}")
        print("✅ Model test successful!")
        
        return True
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ ERROR: Failed to create model: {e}")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Minimal ArcFace TensorFlow Lite Model Creator")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    success = create_minimal_arcface_tflite()
    
    if success:
        print("\n🎉 SUCCESS!")
        print("Minimal TensorFlow Lite model created and tested!")
        print("This model can be loaded by TensorFlow Lite Unity plugin.")
        print("Note: This is a simplified model for testing - it won't have")
        print("the same accuracy as your original ArcFace model, but it will")
        print("prove that the TensorFlow Lite pipeline works.")
    else:
        print("\n❌ FAILED!")
        print("Could not create minimal model.")
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;
using TensorFlowLite;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Face recognition using TensorFlow Lite Unity plugin.
    /// This is the ACTUAL TensorFlow Lite implementation we promised!
    /// </summary>
    public class TensorFlowLiteRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("TensorFlow Lite Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to TensorFlow Lite model in StreamingAssets")]
        public string modelPath = "arcface.tflite";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for recognition (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;
        
        [Tooltip("Use fallback mode (simple features) if model loading fails")]
        public bool useFallbackIfModelFails = true;

        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private const int FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE = 64; // Simple feature extraction size (fallback mode)
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private Interpreter _tfliteInterpreter; // TensorFlow Lite interpreter
        private bool _isInitialized = false;
        private bool _isUsingFallbackMode = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing TensorFlow Lite Recognizer...");
            
            // Try to load TensorFlow Lite model first
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadTensorFlowLiteModelCoroutine());
            
            // Load embeddings
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                if (_tfliteInterpreter != null)
                {
                    Debug.Log("✅ TensorFlow Lite Recognizer fully initialized in FULL MODE (TensorFlow Lite model loaded)!");
                }
                else if (_isUsingFallbackMode)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Running in FALLBACK MODE (simple features) - accuracy may be lower");
                    Debug.LogWarning("💡 TensorFlow Lite model failed to load - check model file and format");
                }
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ TensorFlow Lite Recognizer initialization failed - No embeddings loaded");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load TensorFlow Lite model
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadTensorFlowLiteModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Attempting to load TensorFlow Lite model from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, copy from StreamingAssets to persistent data path
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Model file not found: {www.error}");
                        if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                        {
                            Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                            _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                        }
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ TensorFlow Lite model not found: {fullPath}");
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            try
            {
                // Load TensorFlow Lite model
                byte[] modelData = File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
                _tfliteInterpreter = new Interpreter(modelData);
                
                if (_tfliteInterpreter == null)
                {
                    throw new System.Exception("TensorFlow Lite Interpreter creation failed");
                }
                
                // Allocate tensors
                _tfliteInterpreter.AllocateTensors();
                
                Debug.Log("✅ TensorFlow Lite model loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load TensorFlow Lite model: {e.Message}");
                
                if (useFallbackIfModelFails)
                {
                    Debug.Log("🔄 Switching to fallback mode...");
                    _isUsingFallbackMode = true;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from JSON file
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading embeddings from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, use UnityWebRequest
            using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
            {
                yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                
                if (www.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                {
                    string jsonContent = www.downloadHandler.text;
                    LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(jsonContent);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to load embeddings: {www.error}");
                }
            }
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                string jsonContent = File.ReadAllText(fullPath);
                LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(jsonContent);
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {fullPath}");
            }
#endif
            yield break;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parse embeddings from JSON content
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadEmbeddingsFromJson(string jsonContent)
        {
            try
            {
                var embeddingsData = JsonUtility.FromJson<PreprocessorEmbeddingsData>(jsonContent);
                _knownEmbeddings.Clear();
                
                foreach (var person in embeddingsData.embeddings)
                {
                    List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                    foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                    {
                        embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                    }
                    _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
                }
                
                Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people");
                
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    foreach (var kvp in _knownEmbeddings)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"   - {kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value.Count} embeddings");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to parse embeddings JSON: {e.Message}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate ArcFace embedding using TensorFlow Lite model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateTensorFlowLiteEmbedding(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (_tfliteInterpreter == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ TensorFlow Lite interpreter not available, using fallback");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }

            try
            {
                // Resize to model input size
                OpenCvSharp.Mat resized = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new OpenCvSharp.Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));
                
                // Convert to RGB (OpenCV loads as BGR)
                OpenCvSharp.Mat rgb = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.CvtColor(resized, rgb, OpenCvSharp.ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);
                
                // Prepare input tensor data
                float[,,,] inputTensor = new float[1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3];
                
                // Get pixel data and populate tensor
                var pixelData = rgb.GetArray(out byte[] pixels);
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        int pixelIndex = y * MODEL_INPUT_SIZE * 3 + x * 3;
                        
                        // Normalize to [0,1] and set tensor values
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 0] = pixels[pixelIndex + 0] / 255.0f;     // R
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 1] = pixels[pixelIndex + 1] / 255.0f;     // G
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 2] = pixels[pixelIndex + 2] / 255.0f;     // B
                    }
                }
                
                // Set input tensor
                _tfliteInterpreter.SetInputTensorData(0, inputTensor);
                
                // Run inference
                _tfliteInterpreter.Invoke();
                
                // Get output tensor
                float[] output = new float[512]; // Typical ArcFace embedding size
                _tfliteInterpreter.GetOutputTensorData(0, output);
                
                // Cleanup
                resized.Dispose();
                rgb.Dispose();
                
                return output;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ TensorFlow Lite inference failed: {e.Message}");
                return ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features as fallback (LBPH-like approach)
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Resize to standard size
                OpenCvSharp.Mat resized = new OpenCvSharp.Mat();
                OpenCvSharp.Cv2.Resize(faceGrayMat, resized, new OpenCvSharp.Size(64, 64));
                
                // Extract histogram features
                float[] features = new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE];
                
                // Simple histogram-based features
                for (int i = 0; i < FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE; i++)
                {
                    int x = (i * 64) / FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE;
                    int y = (i * 64) / FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE;
                    features[i] = resized.Get<byte>(y, x) / 255.0f;
                }
                
                resized.Dispose();
                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Simple feature extraction failed: {e.Message}");
                return new float[FALLBACK_FEATURE_SIZE]; // Return zero features
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize face using either TensorFlow Lite model or fallback features
        /// </summary>
        public string RecognizeFace(OpenCvSharp.Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return "System not initialized";
            }

            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return "No known faces loaded";
            }

            try
            {
                // Generate embedding
                float[] liveEmbedding = _tfliteInterpreter != null ? GenerateTensorFlowLiteEmbedding(faceGrayMat) : ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
                string mode = _tfliteInterpreter != null ? "TensorFlow Lite" : "Fallback";
                
                if (liveEmbedding == null || liveEmbedding.Length == 0)
                {
                    return "Failed to extract features";
                }

                // Find best match
                string bestMatch = "Unknown";
                float bestSimilarity = 0f;
                
                foreach (var kvp in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    string personName = kvp.Key;
                    List<float[]> storedEmbeddings = kvp.Value;
                    
                    foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in storedEmbeddings)
                    {
                        float similarity = CalculateCosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                        
                        if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                        {
                            bestSimilarity = similarity;
                            bestMatch = personName;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Apply threshold
                if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
                {
                    // Check if person should be shown as anonymous
                    if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                    {
                        bestMatch = "Unknown";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    bestMatch = "Unknown";
                }

                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"[{mode}] Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                }

                return bestMatch;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Face recognition failed: {e.Message}");
                return "Recognition failed";
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings
        /// </summary>
        private float CalculateCosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️ Embedding length mismatch: {embedding1.Length} vs {embedding2.Length}");
                return 0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            float norm1 = 0f;
            float norm2 = 0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                norm1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                norm2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            if (norm1 == 0f || norm2 == 0f)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            return dotProduct / (Mathf.Sqrt(norm1) * Mathf.Sqrt(norm2));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Check if system is ready for recognition
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsReady()
        {
            return _isInitialized && _knownEmbeddings.Count > 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Check if using full TensorFlow Lite mode or fallback
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsUsingFullMode()
        {
            return _tfliteInterpreter != null && !_isUsingFallbackMode;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _tfliteInterpreter?.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
/* DEPRECATED: This file is no longer used. Use FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor (Editor-only) and LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer (Runtime) instead.
 * 
 * The new approach:
 * 1. FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor runs on PC to generate embeddings using the large model
 * 2. LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer loads the tiny embeddings file on Magic Leap 2
 * 
 * This avoids loading large models at runtime on the device.
 */

using UnityEngine;
using Unity.Barracuda;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using OpenCvSharp;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// DEPRECATED: Use FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor + LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer instead
    /// </summary>
    public class FaceEmbeddingGenerator : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Barracuda Model Settings")]
        [Tooltip("The ONNX model asset for face embedding generation")]
        public NNModel faceNetModel;
        
        [Tooltip("Input tensor name in the ONNX model")]
        public string inputName = "input";
        
        [Tooltip("Output tensor name in the ONNX model")]
        public string outputName = "output";
        
        [Header("Recognition Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for face matching (0.0 = identical, 1.0 = completely different)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.6f;
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging for embedding generation")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;

        // Private fields
        private IWorker _worker;
        private bool _isInitialized = false;
        private Dictionary<string, float[]> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, float[]>();
        
        // FaceNet model expects 160x160 RGB images
        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 160;
        private const int EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = 128; // FaceNet typically outputs 128D embeddings

        void Start()
        {
            // DEPRECATED: This script is no longer used. Disabling to prevent errors.
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ FaceEmbeddingGenerator is DEPRECATED. Please remove this component and use TensorFlowLiteRecognizer instead.");
            enabled = false;
            return;
            
            // InitializeBarracuda(); // Disabled
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            CleanupBarracuda();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initialize Barracuda worker with the FaceNet model
        /// </summary>
        private void InitializeBarracuda()
        {
            if (faceNetModel == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ FaceNet model is not assigned! Please assign an ONNX model in the Inspector.");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // Create Barracuda worker
                var model = ModelLoader.Load(faceNetModel);
                _worker = WorkerFactory.CreateWorker(WorkerFactory.Type.Auto, model);
                _isInitialized = true;
                
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log("✅ Barracuda FaceEmbeddingGenerator initialized successfully!");
                    Debug.Log($"📊 Model input size: {MODEL_INPUT_SIZE}x{MODEL_INPUT_SIZE}");
                    Debug.Log($"📊 Embedding dimension: {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION}");
                }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to initialize Barracuda: {e.Message}");
                _isInitialized = false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Clean up Barracuda resources
        /// </summary>
        private void CleanupBarracuda()
        {
            if (_worker != null)
            {
                _worker.Dispose();
                _worker = null;
            }
            _isInitialized = false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate face embedding from a detected face region
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="faceMat">OpenCV Mat containing the face region</param>
        /// <returns>128D embedding vector, or null if failed</returns>
        public float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Barracuda not initialized! Cannot generate embedding.");
                return null;
            }

            try
            {
                // Preprocess face for FaceNet model
                Mat processedFace = PreprocessFaceForModel(faceMat);
                if (processedFace == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to preprocess face for model");
                    return null;
                }

                // Convert OpenCV Mat to Barracuda tensor
                Tensor inputTensor = ConvertMatToTensor(processedFace);
                if (inputTensor == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to convert Mat to Tensor");
                    processedFace.Dispose();
                    return null;
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor outputTensor = _worker.PeekOutput(outputName);
                
                // Extract embedding
                float[] embedding = new float[EMBEDDING_DIMENSION];
                outputTensor.ToReadOnlyArray().CopyTo(embedding, 0);

                // Normalize embedding (L2 normalization for cosine similarity)
                NormalizeEmbedding(embedding);

                // Cleanup
                inputTensor.Dispose();
                outputTensor.Dispose();
                processedFace.Dispose();

                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"🎯 Generated embedding: {embedding.Length}D vector");
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Preprocess face image for FaceNet model input
        /// </summary>
        private Mat PreprocessFaceForModel(Mat faceMat)
        {
            try
            {
                // Convert to RGB if needed
                Mat rgbFace = new Mat();
                if (faceMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceMat, rgbFace, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else if (faceMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceMat, rgbFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌ Unsupported face image channels: {faceMat.Channels()}");
                    return null;
                }

                // Resize to model input size (160x160)
                Mat resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbFace, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE), 
                          interpolation: InterpolationFlags.Linear);

                // Normalize pixel values to [0, 1] range
                Mat normalized = new Mat();
                resized.ConvertTo(normalized, MatType.CV_32F, 1.0 / 255.0);

                // Cleanup intermediate mats
                rgbFace.Dispose();
                resized.Dispose();

                return normalized;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error preprocessing face: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Convert OpenCV Mat to Barracuda Tensor
        /// </summary>
        private Tensor ConvertMatToTensor(Mat mat)
        {
            try
            {
                // FaceNet expects (1, 160, 160, 3) tensor format
                // Unity Barracuda expects (batch, height, width, channels)
                var tensorShape = new TensorShape(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                var tensorData = new float[tensorShape.length];

                // Copy data from Mat to tensor array
                // OpenCV Mat is (height, width, channels), we need (batch, height, width, channels)
                unsafe
                {
                    float* matPtr = (float*)mat.DataPointer;
                    for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                    {
                        for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                        {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
                            {
                                int matIndex = y * MODEL_INPUT_SIZE * 3 + x * 3 + c;
                                int tensorIndex = y * MODEL_INPUT_SIZE * 3 + x * 3 + c;
                                tensorData[tensorIndex] = matPtr[matIndex];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                return new Tensor(tensorShape, tensorData);
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error converting Mat to Tensor: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalize embedding vector using L2 normalization
        /// </summary>
        private void NormalizeEmbedding(float[] embedding)
        {
            float magnitude = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < embedding.Length; i++)
            {
                magnitude += embedding[i] * embedding[i];
            }
            magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

            if (magnitude > 0f)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < embedding.Length; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] /= magnitude;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public float CalculateSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1 == null || embedding2 == null || embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                return 0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            return dotProduct; // Already normalized, so dot product = cosine similarity
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Add a known face embedding to the database
        /// </summary>
        public void AddKnownFace(string name, float[] embedding)
        {
            if (embedding != null && embedding.Length == EMBEDDING_DIMENSION)
            {
                _knownEmbeddings[name] = embedding;
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Added known face: {name} ({embedding.Length}D embedding)");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Invalid embedding for {name}: expected {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION}D, got {embedding?.Length ?? 0}D");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face using Barracuda embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding for the input face
            float[] inputEmbedding = GenerateEmbedding(faceMat);
            if (inputEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0f);
            }

            // Find best match
            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float bestSimilarity = 0f;

            foreach (var kvp in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                float similarity = CalculateSimilarity(inputEmbedding, kvp.Value);
                if (similarity > bestSimilarity)
                {
                    bestSimilarity = similarity;
                    bestMatch = kvp.Key;
                }
            }

            // Check if similarity meets threshold
            if (bestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"🎯 Barracuda Recognition: {bestMatch} (similarity: {bestSimilarity:F3})");
                }
                return (bestMatch, bestSimilarity);
            }
            else
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"❌ No match found (best: {bestMatch} with {bestSimilarity:F3}, threshold: {similarityThreshold:F3})");
                }
                return ("Unknown", bestSimilarity);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Clear all known face embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public void ClearKnownFaces()
        {
            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log("🗑️ Cleared all known face embeddings");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Get the number of known faces
        /// </summary>
        public int GetKnownFaceCount()
        {
            return _knownEmbeddings.Count;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Check if Barracuda is properly initialized
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsInitialized()
        {
            return _isInitialized;
        }
    }
}
```
